name: fin-portfolio
description: 아침 경제 브리핑 모노레포 — apps/api(FastAPI·수집·GPT 요약) + apps/web(React PWA)

scripts.format: uv --directory apps/api run ruff format . && pnpm --filter web format
scripts.check:api: uv --directory apps/api run ruff format --check . && uv --directory apps/api run ruff check . && uv --directory apps/api run pytest
scripts.check:web: pnpm --filter web format:check && pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter web build
